reason: Primary source identity is confirmed via the attached reprint of Schwarz, Strack, & Mai (1991), Public Opinion Quarterly, 55, 3–23. The target analysis on printed p. 11 is the unique z-test (z = 2.32, p < .01) comparing the correlation in the general-specific control condition (r = .32) against the one-specific-general condition without joint lead-in (r = .67); Table I explicitly specifies N = 50 per cell for both mutually exclusive randomized conditions (50 + 50 = 100 analytic respondents), as neither is the joint-lead-in condition (N = 56).
